title: Ninja 500 SE (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing Kawasaki's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Kawasaki Ninja 500 SE (Classic Heritage) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 500cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
